name: Niizuma Tokusou Patoreiza ~Ryakudatsu Tengoku Hen~
original_name: 新妻特捜パトレイザー ～略奪天獄篇～
source:
In the near future, mysterious Paramecia Getter Rays raining down from space have awakened supernatural abilities in certain humans—now called Paramecia Humans.
In response to the surge in Paramecia Human-related crimes, Japan privatized part of its police force, tasking them with handling these new threats.
One of the leading private security organizations tackling these crimes is Lady Decker, Inc.
Their cutting-edge equipment, Battle Powered, can only be operated by individuals with a specific aptitude—
and, purely by coincidence, all of those individuals happen to be married women.
Thus begins the story of three beautiful newlyweds, code-named The Newlywed Special Unit Patrollers…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008526.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
在不远的未来，神秘的帕拉梅西亚射线从太空落下，使部分人类觉醒了超能力。这些人如今被称为帕拉梅西亚人。

面对与帕拉梅西亚人有关的犯罪激增，日本将部分警察职能私有化，交给私人机构处理这些新威胁。

莱蒂·德克尔公司是负责处理此类犯罪的领先私人安保组织之一。

他们最先进的设备“战斗动力”只能由拥有特定资质的人操作——而纯属巧合的是，所有符合条件的人都是已婚女性。

三名美丽新婚妻子、代号“新婚特别巡逻队”的故事就此开始……
